title: Nepal Securities Board Sets Basis for IPO Premium Pricing - Ratopati
description: Nepal Securities Board Sets Basis for IPO Premium Pricing  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Nepal Securities Board has prepared the basis for determining the price of public offerings issued at a premium price.

Amidst claims of manipulation in the IPO approval and pricing process, the board has made such arrangements to stop arbitrary price determination. This arrangement is for offerings made through methods other than the book-building system.

The board has set such a basis through the 'Primary Capital Market Reform Policy, 2083'. According to the new policy, companies will no longer be able to arbitrarily propose a premium price for IPOs.

The board has set five bases for the IPO price. It has been informed that such pricing will be based on the analysis of the company's actual condition, the use of scientific valuation methods, diversification in the pricing system, sector-specific criteria, and the protection of small investors.

Under the analysis of the company's actual condition, when determining the IPO price, the company's actual financial condition, total assets, earning capacity, cash flow, business risk, overall industry condition, and future growth prospects will have to be considered.

From this basis, one or more scientific methods will be used for price determination. For this, depending on the nature of the company, methods practiced internationally such as Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Comparable Company Analysis, Net Asset Value, and Earnings Multiplier have been arranged to be adopted.

Although the board has adopted a policy of promoting book-building and hybrid pricing systems in addition to the traditional fixed price system. The board has stated that it will be implemented according to market needs and the nature of the company.

The board has also stated that it will prepare separate bases for IPO price determination based on different sectors. Since the nature of banks and financial institutions, insurance, hydropower, manufacturing industries, information technology, and startup companies are different, the board's policy is to consider the specific financial and business characteristics of the respective sectors when evaluating them.

The board has also made a policy arrangement that companies must clearly disclose in the prospectus how the IPO price was determined. It has been arranged to publicly disclose in an easily understandable manner for the general public which basis, assumptions, and key financial indicators were used to set the price.

The board has also adopted a policy of strictly discouraging actions that put small investors at undue risk or artificially inflate or deflate prices. The issuance and sales manager and the valuer involved in the pricing process must work independently without any conflict of interest.

Nepal Securities Board Spokesperson Niranjaya Ghimire said that the policy was brought as per the suggestion of the Primary Market Reform Facilitation Task Force formed by the board.

The document states that the board has set policies for the reform of all sectors towards IPO issuance, and the policy related to price determination is one of its important aspects, he said.

काठमांडू। नेपाल प्रतिभूति बोर्ड प्रीमियम मूल्य पर जारी सार्वजनिक प्रस्तावक मूल्य निर्धारित करबाक आधार तैयार केलक अछि ।

आईपीओ मंजूरी आ मूल्य निर्धारण प्रक्रिया मे हेरफेर क दावा क बीच बोर्ड मनमाना मूल्य निर्धारण कए रोकबा लेल एहन व्यवस्था केलक अछि। ई व्यवस्था पुस्तक निर्माण प्रणाली के अलावा अन्य तरीका के माध्यम स॑ करलऽ जाय वाला प्रसाद के लेलऽ छै ।

बोर्ड न॑ ‘प्राथमिक पूंजी बाजार सुधार नीति, 2083’ के माध्यम स॑ ऐसनऽ आधार तय करलकै । नव नीति क अनुसार आब कंपनी आईपीओ क लेल प्रीमियम मूल्य मनमाना तरीका स नहि प्रस्तावित क सकैत अछि।

बोर्ड आईपीओ क दाम क लेल पांचटा आधार तय केलक अछि। ई जानकारी देलऽ गेलऽ छै कि ऐसनऽ मूल्य निर्धारण कंपनी केरऽ वास्तविक स्थिति के विश्लेषण, वैज्ञानिक मूल्यांकन विधि के उपयोग, मूल्य निर्धारण प्रणाली म॑ विविधता, क्षेत्र-विशिष्ट मानदंड, आरू छोटऽ निवेशकऽ के सुरक्षा के आधार प॑ करलऽ जैतै ।

कंपनी कें वास्तविक स्थिति कें विश्लेषण कें तहत आईपीओ मूल्य कें निर्धारण करय कें समय कंपनी कें वास्तविक वित्तीय स्थिति, कुल संपत्ति, कमाई क्षमता, नकदी प्रवाह, व्यवसायिक जोखिम, समग्र उद्योग कें स्थिति, आ भविष्य कें विकास संभावनाक पर विचार करय कें होयत.

एहि आधार स मूल्य निर्धारण लेल एक या एक स बेसी वैज्ञानिक तरीका क उपयोग कैल जाएत। एकरा लेली कंपनी केरऽ प्रकृति के आधार प॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर प॑ अभ्यास करलऽ जाय वाला विधियऽ जैना कि डिस्काउंट कैश फ्लो (डीसीएफ), तुलनीय कंपनी विश्लेषण, शुद्ध संपत्ति मूल्य, आरू कमाई गुणक क॑ अपनाबै के व्यवस्था करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

हालांकि बोर्ड न॑ पारंपरिक फिक्स्ड प्राइस सिस्टम के अलावा बुक-बिल्डिंग आरू हाइब्रिड प्राइसिंग सिस्टम क॑ बढ़ावा दै के नीति अपनान॑ छै । बोर्ड के कहनाय छनि जे एकरा बाजार के जरूरत आओर कंपनी के प्रकृति के हिसाब सं लागू कएल जाएत.

बोर्ड न॑ ई भी बतैलकै कि हुनी अलग-अलग क्षेत्रऽ के आधार प॑ आईपीओ केरऽ मूल्य निर्धारण लेली अलग-अलग आधार तैयार करतै । चूँकि बैंक आ वित्तीय संस्थान, बीमा, जलविद्युत, विनिर्माण उद्योग, सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी, आ स्टार्टअप कंपनीक कें प्रकृति अलग-अलग छै, अइ कें लेल बोर्ड कें नीति छै की ओकर मूल्यांकन करय कें समय संबंधित क्षेत्रक कें विशिष्ट वित्तीय आ व्यवसायिक विशेषताक पर विचार करनाय.

बोर्ड नीतिगत व्यवस्था सेहो केलक अछि जे कंपनी कए प्रोस्पेक्टस मे स्पष्ट रूप स इ बताबय पड़त जे आईपीओ क दाम कोना तय भेल। एकरऽ व्यवस्था करलऽ गेलऽ छै कि आम जनता लेली आसानी स॑ समझै वाला तरीका स॑ सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ खुलासा करलऽ जाय कि कीमत निर्धारित करै लेली कोन आधार, धारणा, आरू प्रमुख वित्तीय सूचकऽ के उपयोग करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

बोर्ड न॑ ऐन्हऽ कार्रवाई क॑ सख्ती स॑ हतोत्साहित करै के नीति भी अपनान॑ छै जेकरा स॑ छोटऽ निवेशकऽ क॑ अनुचित जोखिम म॑ डाललऽ जाय छै या कृत्रिम रूप स॑ दाम बढ़ैलऽ जाय छै या उतारलऽ जाय छै । जारी करय आ बिक्री प्रबंधक आ मूल्य निर्धारण प्रक्रिया मे शामिल मूल्यांकनकर्ता कें बिना कोनों हित कें टकराव कें स्वतंत्र रूप सं काज करनाय आवश्यक छै.

नेपाल प्रतिभूति बोर्डके प्रवक्ता निरंजय घिमिरे बोर्डद्वारा गठित प्राथमिक बाजार सुधार सुविधा कार्यदलके सुझावके अनुसार नीति आनल गेल बटैलै ।

हुनी कहलकै कि दस्तावेज मँ कहलौ गेलौ छै कि बोर्ड नँ आईपीओ जारी करै के दिशा मँ सब क्षेत्र मँ सुधार लेली नीति तय करलकै, आरू मूल्य निर्धारण सँ जुड़लौ नीति ओकरौ महत्वपूर्ण पहलू मँ सँ एक छै ।

title: Nepal's ex-PM Deuba returns home to face graft probe - TRT World
description: Nepal's ex-PM Deuba returns home to face graft probe  TRT World
publisher.title: TRT World
full_article:
Former Nepal prime minister Sher Bahadur Deuba, facing arrest for alleged corruption, returned home on Thursday, six months after leaving for medical treatment abroad.

The veteran leader of the opposition Nepali Congress party waved and smiled as hundreds of supporters lined up the streets leading to Tribhuvan airport in the capital, Kathmandu.

In April, police issued an arrest warrant for Deuba over money laundering charges, making him the latest high-profile figure targeted under the new government of Prime Minister Balendra Shah.

Deuba, 80, who left Nepal in February, has denied the allegations.

Nepal police spokesperson Abi Narayan Kafle said Deuba's case is being handled by the Department of Money Laundering Investigation.

Related TRT World - Nepal's 'fierce' ex-guerrilla chief becomes new prime minister

"We are giving security for him at the airport and to his rally because he is a former prime minister," Kafle told AFP .

Authorities had also issued a warrant for Deuba's wife, former foreign minister Arzu Rana Deuba.

The warrants were issued a month after Shah won a landslide victory on a platform of youth-driven political change in the first elections since deadly protests in September 2025.

Deuba's tenure as president of the Nepali Congress ended in January, after younger members pushed for a leadership change.

title: UNESCO, MoCTCA lunch workshop to document Nepal's intangible cultural heritage - The Himalayan Times
description: UNESCO, MoCTCA lunch workshop to document Nepal's intangible cultural heritage  The Himalayan Times
publisher.title: The Himalayan Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU, AUGUST 13

The Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, with support from UNESCO, has launched a six-day community-based workshop to strengthen the documentation and safeguarding of Nepal's intangible cultural heritage.

The workshop, part of the programme "Development of Inventory of Intangible Cultural Heritage Covering All Seven Provinces of Nepal," brought together 40 participants, including 16 women and 24 men. Youth accounted for 30 percent of the participants.

Representatives of the Newa, Tamang, Chepang, Thami, Gurung and Siyar Indigenous communities from Bagmati and Gandaki provinces, along with municipal officials and ministry representatives, participated in the workshop.

Opening the programme, Ministry Joint Secretary Suresh Suras Shrestha highlighted Nepal's policies and legal frameworks for safeguarding intangible cultural heritage and reaffirmed the government's commitment to working with UNESCO on the initiative.

The workshop is the first of three six-day community-based workshops being conducted under the 2003 UNESCO Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage.

Participants were trained in documenting cultural practices and developing community-led inventories, with emphasis on ensuring that cultural knowledge, practices and traditions are transmitted from one generation to another.

UNESCO Representative to Nepal Jaco du Toit said the initiative aims to document at least 20 intangible cultural heritage elements from 17 Indigenous communities across all seven provinces.

As part of the practical training, participants visited Bhaktapur, where they observed and documented Gathamuga, a post-harvest Newa festival. The field exercise was facilitated by representatives of Ward 9 and Newa Dey Daboo and included interaction with local government representatives at the Ward Office in Dattatraya.

The workshop also emphasised ethical, community-led documentation, including the importance of obtaining consent as an ongoing process based on trust and participation rather than as a one-time formality.

Participants are expected to use the skills and tools gained through the workshop to help communities document, validate, maintain and transmit their living cultural heritage.

व्यावहारिक प्रशिक्षण के हिस्सा के रूप में प्रतिभागी भक्तपुर के दौरा केलनि, जतय ओ सब फसल के बाद के नेवा पर्व गाथामुगा के अवलोकन आ दस्तावेजीकरण केलनि। फील्ड अभ्यास के सुविधा वार्ड 9 आ नेवा देय दाबू के प्रतिनिधि केने छल आ दत्तात्राय के वार्ड कार्यालय में स्थानीय सरकार के प्रतिनिधि के संग बातचीत शामिल छल।

कार्यशाला म॑ नैतिक, समुदाय के नेतृत्व वाला दस्तावेजीकरण प॑ भी जोर देलऽ गेलै, जेकरा म॑ एक बार के औपचारिकता के रूप म॑ नै बल्कि विश्वास आरू भागीदारी प॑ आधारित एगो जारी प्रक्रिया के रूप म॑ सहमति प्राप्त करै के महत्व भी शामिल छै ।

प्रतिभागियक सं अपेक्षा कैल जायत छै की ओ कार्यशाला कें माध्यम सं प्राप्त कौशल आ उपकरणक कें उपयोग समुदायक कें अपन जीवित सांस्कृतिक विरासत कें दस्तावेजीकरण, मान्यता, रखरखाव आ संचरण मे मदद करय कें लेल करय.

title: Former Nepal PM Deuba returns amid money-laundering investigation - The Assam Tribune

full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug,13: Former Nepali Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba on Thursday returned home to a rousing welcome from his supporters at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, five months after he had left for Singapore to get a “medical check-up".

A large crowd of leaders and party workers, including former office-bearers of the party — then acting President Purna Bahadur Khadka, Krishna Prasad Sitaula, Prakash Man Singh, Bimalendra Nidhi and Prakash Sharan Mahat, among others welcomed Deuba as he arrived at the airport via Thailand.

Supporters chanted slogans in support of Deuba who is facing both legal and political challenge at home as he was ousted by the contested Special General Convention in January.

Deuba had left the country on February 25 for Singapore, reportedly for a “medical check-up”, and stayed abroad for months as he faced a money-laundering investigation after large amounts of cash were seen being burnt by protesters at his residence during the GenZ movement in September last year.

Nepali authorities have already frozen his domestic assets and bank accounts as part of the ongoing investigation.

Days after the current government, led by Prime Minister Balendra Shah, came to power, arrest warrants were issued against Deuba and his wife at the request of the Department of Money Laundering Investigation.

The Nepali government had earlier made an unsuccessful attempt to have a Red Corner Notice issued in his name by Interpol while he was abroad.

The Supreme Court subsequently annulled the arrest warrant on May 25, which possibly led Deuba to decide to return home.

His return comes at a time when his party is moving towards a possible split, with his faction scheduled to organise a national gathering of cadres in Kathmandu on Friday.

Former General Secretary of the party Shashanka Koirala is leading the effort to hold the separate gathering, as the faction remains hopeful that the Supreme Court will invalidate the party’s Special General Convention held in January, which elected a new Central Working Committee headed by Gagan Thapa as president, replacing then-incumbent President Deuba.

Earlier, the Supreme Court had legitimised the Special General Convention, allowing the grand old party to contest the elections under Thapa’s leadership.

The party subsequently suffered a humiliating defeat in the March 5 elections, prompting sharp criticism of Thapa’s leadership from the Deuba faction.

The faction had sought a review of the Supreme Court’s April 17 verdict that granted legitimacy to the Thapa-led faction.

Last week, however, the Supreme Court allowed the review petition, sending the case back for a fresh hearing before a three-judge bench. The outcome of the new hearing will determine the party’s official status.

Although his return could energise his faction within the party, it remains unclear how the state will treat him given the ongoing investigation against him and his wife, former Foreign Minister Arzu Deuba, who accompanied him abroad.

His wife and son, Jayabir, have not returned home from abroad. Deuba and his wife, who were badly beaten by protesters during the Gen-Z movement last year, left the country citing medical treatment, but their prolonged stay abroad remained unexplained.

The couple has not publicly disclosed details of their movements abroad, nor have they specified what ailments the former Prime Minister was being treated for.

During this period, they were believed to have moved from Singapore to Hong Kong. Videos of the Deubas strolling in Hong Kong have surfaced on social media from time to time, although the couple never explicitly confirmed that they were in Hong Kong.

More significantly, questions remain over who financed their extended stay and medical treatment. These questions have assumed greater significance amid the ongoing money-laundering investigation into the Deuba family.

--IANS

एकरऽ बाद ५ मार्च केरऽ चुनाव म॑ पार्टी क॑ अपमानजनक हार के सामना करना पड़लै, जेकरा चलतें देउबा गुट स॑ थापा केरऽ नेतृत्व केरऽ तीक्ष्ण आलोचना करलऽ गेलै ।

गुट सुप्रीम कोर्ट के 17 अप्रैल के फैसला के समीक्षा करय के मांग केने छल जे थापा के नेतृत्व वाला गुट के वैधता प्रदान केलक अछि.

मुदा पिछला सप्ताह सुप्रीम कोर्ट समीक्षा याचिका कए अनुमति द देलक, जाहि स एहि मामला कए तीन जज क पीठ क समक्ष नव सुनवाई लेल वापस पठा देल गेल। नव सुनवाई के परिणाम पार्टी के आधिकारिक दर्जा तय करत.

हालांकि हुनकऽ वापसी स॑ पार्टी के भीतर हुनकऽ गुट ऊर्जावान होय ​​सकै छै, लेकिन हुनका आरू हुनकऽ साथ विदेश म॑ गेलऽ हुनकऽ पत्नी पूर्व विदेश मंत्री अर्जू देउबा के खिलाफ जारी जांच क॑ देखत॑ हुअ॑ राज्य हुनका साथ केना व्यवहार करतै, ई साफ नै छै ।

पत्नी आ बेटा जयबीर विदेशसँ घर नहि घुरल अछि । पिछला साल जेन-जेड आन्दोलन के दौरान प्रदर्शनकारी द्वारा बहुत मारल गेल देउबा आ हुनकर पत्नी चिकित्सा के हवाला दैत देश छोड़ि देलक, मुदा विदेश मे लंबा समय तक रहबाक कोनो स्पष्टता नहि बनल।

ई जोड़ी न॑ सार्वजनिक तौर प॑ विदेशऽ म॑ अपनऽ आवाजाही के विवरण नै बतैलकै, नै ही ई बात क॑ बतैलकै कि पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ कोन-कोन बीमारी के इलाज करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छेलै ।

एहि दौरान मानल जाइत छल जे ओ सब सिंगापुर स हांगकांग चलि गेलाह। हांगकांग में टहलैत देउबा के वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर बीच-बीच में सामने आबि रहल अछि, हालांकि ई जोड़ी कहियो स्पष्ट रूप सं पुष्टि नहिं केलक जे ओ हांगकांग में अछि.

एहि स बेसी महत्वपूर्ण बात इ अछि जे एहि पर सवाल बनल अछि जे हुनकर विस्तारित प्रवास आ चिकित्सा क वित्तपोषण के केलक। देउबा परिवार पर जारी मनी लांड्रिंग जांच के बीच ई सब सवाल के महत्व बेसी भ गेल अछि.

title: Nepal May Have Lost Papers Of 1816 Treaty With India At Heart Of Its Border Claim - NDTV
description: Nepal May Have Lost Papers Of 1816 Treaty With India At Heart Of Its Border Claim  NDTV

full_article:
Nepal may have lost the original documents of the 1816 Sugauli Treaty. Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal has indicated on the floor of Nepal's Parliament's lower house (House of Representatives or Pratinidhi Sabha) that the government cannot confirm if it possesses the original document of the 1816 Sugauli Treaty.

While some papers exist in the National Archives, extensive searches across state departments failed to locate the definitive, original signed document, the minister confirmed.

"The Government of Nepal does not have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents. There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we do not have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties," Khanal said.

In 2019, Nepal's then Foreign Minister, Pradeep Gyawali had said that Nepal possessed copies of the treaties.

The 1816 Sugauli Treaty, signed with British-ruled India (East India Company) after the Anglo-Nepalese War from 1814-1816 forms the fundamental legal basis for Nepal's modern territorial claims. The signatories of the treaty were Lieutenant Colonel Paris Bradshaw on behalf of the East India Company and Raj Guru Gajraj Mishra on behalf of the ruler of Nepal, King Girvan Yuddha Bikram Shah.

However, the Sugauli Treaty is a pre-independence document and since India gained independence it has been conducting foreign relations with Nepal largely on the basis of other documents as well while the Sugauli Treaty remains a key foundational document.

Today the India-Nepal border is managed through the Indo-Nepal Treaty of Peace and Friendship (1950) and technical documents produced by joint bilateral working groups.

The main dispute along the border is over the 'Kalapani' region in the Greater Himalayas which is within India's borders. When the Home Ministry issued new maps in 2019, Nepal objected to the map, claiming it identifies the region as 'an unsettled territory of the Darchula district' within Nepal's Sudurpashchim province.

The India-Nepal border dispute has intensified after the India-China agreement to reopen the Lipulekh Pass trade route. Nepal claims that Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura and Kalapani are its territories, whereas India says that the territories are a part of India.

In June this year, Nepal Prime Minister Balen Shah claimed that the Himalayan nation had also encroached on Indian territory despite Kathmandu's consistent complaints about alleged Indian encroachment.

Nepal's Foreign Affairs Ministry reiterated that Nepal's official position regarding disputed border areas, including Limpiyadhura, Lipulekh and Kalapani, remains unchanged and that unresolved border issues would be addressed through diplomatic dialogue and mutual understanding with India.

In subsequent statements, Nepal has indicated that it is seeking to resolve the issue rather than prolong it, clearly stating it wants strengthen bilateral partnerships.

Speaking at the International Conference on China and South Asia in a Multipolar World: China-India-Nepal Trilateral Relations in an Evolving Regional Order, Nepal Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said, "Nepal sincerely welcomes the continued development and prosperity of both our neighbours. We remain committed to further strengthening our longstanding bilateral relations with India and China independently, on the basis of sovereign equality, mutual respect, mutual benefit, and sensitivity to each other's legitimate interests and concerns."



"Nepal will continue to strengthen its bilateral partnerships with both India and China, recognizing the immense value of these longstanding relationships founded on friendship, mutual respect, and mutual benefit. At the same time, Nepal remains firmly committed to promoting regional and sub-regional cooperation that advances connectivity, facilitates commerce, expands markets, and contributes to sustainable development," Khanal added.

नेपाल १८१६ के सुगौली संधि के मूल दस्तावेज गमा चुकल होयत । नेपालके विदेश मन्त्री शिसिर खनाल नेपालके संसदके निचले सदन (प्रतिनिधि सभा वा प्रतिनिधि सभा)के तलमे संकेत देने अछि जे सरकार १८१६के सुगौली संधिके मूल दस्तावेज ओकरा लग अछि कि नहि से पुष्टि नहि कऽ सकैत अछि ।

मंत्री न॑ ई बात के पुष्टि करलकै कि राष्ट्रीय अभिलेखागार म॑ कुछ कागज मौजूद छै, लेकिन राज्य केरऽ विभागऽ म॑ व्यापक खोज स॑ ई निश्चित, मूल हस्ताक्षरित दस्तावेज के पता नै चल॑ सकलऽ छै ।

खनाल कहलनि जे, नेपाल सरकार लग एहि बातक स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे हमरा सब लग आधिकारिक संधि दस्तावेज अछि या नहि, एहन अभिलेख अछि जे किछु संधि स संबंधित किछु दस्तावेज राष्ट्रीय अभिलेखागार मे राखल गेल अछि।मुदा हमरा सब लग स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे ओ वास्तविक आधिकारिक संधि अछि कि नहि।

2019 मे नेपालक तत्कालीन विदेश मंत्री प्रदीप ज्ञवाली नेपाल लग संधि सभक प्रतिलिपि रहल कहने छलाह ।

1814-1816 तक एंग्लो-नेपाली युद्धक बाद ब्रिटिश शासित भारत (ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी) के संग हस्ताक्षरित 1816 के सुगौली संधि नेपाल के आधुनिक क्षेत्रीय दावा के मौलिक कानूनी आधार बनल अछि | संधि पर हस्ताक्षरकर्ता ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के तरफ सं लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल पेरिस ब्रैडशॉ आ नेपाल के शासक राजा गिरवान युद्ध बिक्रम शाह के तरफ सं राज गुरु गजराज मिश्र छलाह.

लेकिन सुगौली संधि स्वतंत्रता पूर्व के दस्तावेज छै आरू जब॑ स॑ भारत क॑ आजादी मिललै तब॑ स॑ ई नेपाल के साथ विदेश संबंध बहुत हद तलक अन्य दस्तावेज के आधार प॑ भी संचालित करी रहलऽ छै जबकि सुगौली संधि एगो प्रमुख आधारभूत दस्तावेज बनलऽ छै ।

आइ भारत-नेपाल सीमाक प्रबंधन भारत-नेपाल शांति आ मैत्री संधि (1950) आ संयुक्त द्विपक्षीय कार्यदल द्वारा निर्मित तकनीकी दस्तावेजक माध्यम सँ कयल जाइत अछि |

सीमा के साथ मुख्य विवाद ग्रेटर हिमालय के ‘कलापानी’ क्षेत्र के ल क छै जे भारत के सीमा के भीतर छै । 2019 मे जखन गृह मंत्रालय नव नक्शा जारी केलक तखन नेपाल एहि नक्शा पर आपत्ति जतौलक आ दावा केलक जे एहि मे नेपालक सुदुरपश्चिम प्रांतक भीतर एहि क्षेत्र केँ ‘दार्चुला जिलाक अशांत क्षेत्र’क रूप मे चिन्हित कयल गेल अछि ।

लिपुलेख दर्रा के व्यापारिक मार्ग के फेर सं खोलय के लेल भारत-चीन समझौता के बाद भारत-नेपाल सीमा विवाद आओर तेज भ गेल अछि. नेपाल के दावा छै कि लिपुलेख, लिम्पियाधुरा आरू कालापानी ओकरऽ क्षेत्र छेकै, जबकि भारत के कहना छै कि ई क्षेत्र भारत केरऽ हिस्सा छेकै ।

एहि वर्ष जून मे नेपालक प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन शाह काठमाण्डौक कथित भारतीय अतिक्रमणक लगातार शिकायत केलाक बादो हिमालय राष्ट्र सेहो भारतीय क्षेत्र अतिक्रमण केने दाबी केने छल ।

नेपाल के विदेश मंत्रालय न॑ दोहरैलकै कि लिम्पियाधुरा, लिपुलेख आरू कालापानी सहित विवादित सीमा क्षेत्र के संबंध म॑ नेपाल केरऽ आधिकारिक स्थिति अपरिवर्तित छै आरू भारत के साथ कूटनीतिक संवाद आरू आपसी समझदारी के माध्यम स॑ सीमा के अनसुलझल मुद्दा के समाधान करलऽ जैतै ।

एकरऽ बाद के बयानऽ म॑ नेपाल न॑ ई बात के संकेत देल॑ छै कि हुनी ई मुद्दा क॑ लम्बा करै के बजाय समाधान करै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छै, ई बात क॑ स्पष्ट रूप स॑ बतैलकै कि हुनी द्विपक्षीय साझेदारी क॑ मजबूत करना चाहै छै ।

बहुध्रुवीय विश्व मे चीन आ दक्षिण एशिया पर अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन : विकसित क्षेत्रीय व्यवस्था मे चीन-भारत-नेपाल त्रिपक्षीय संबंध मे बजैत नेपालक विदेश मंत्री शिसिर खनाल कहलनि जे, "नेपाल अपन दुनू पड़ोसी देशक निरंतर विकास आ समृद्धिक ईमानदारी सँ स्वागत करैत अछि। हम सब भारत आ चीनक संग अपन दीर्घकालीन द्विपक्षीय संबंध केँ स्वतंत्र रूप सँ, सार्वभौमिक समानताक आधार पर, आरो मजबूत करबाक लेल प्रतिबद्ध छी। आपसी सम्मान, आपसी लाभ, आरू एक-दूसरा के जायज हित आरू सरोकार के प्रति संवेदनशीलता."



"नेपाल मित्रता, आपसी सम्मान, आ आपसी लाभ पर आधारित एहि दीर्घकालीन संबंधक अपार मूल्य केँ स्वीकार करैत भारत आ चीन दुनूक संग अपन द्विपक्षीय साझेदारी केँ मजबूत करैत रहत।" एकरऽ साथ ही नेपाल क्षेत्रीय आरू उपक्षेत्रीय सहयोग क॑ बढ़ावा दै लेली दृढ़ता स॑ प्रतिबद्ध छै जे कनेक्टिविटी क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै छै, वाणिज्य क॑ सुविधाजनक बनाबै छै, बाजारऽ के विस्तार करै छै, आरू सतत विकास म॑ योगदान दै छै ।’’ खनाल न॑ आरू कहलकै ।

title: Five killed, eight missing after landslide buries homes in western Nepal - TRT World
description: Five killed, eight missing after landslide buries homes in western Nepal  TRT World
publisher.title: TRT World
full_article:
A landslide swept away houses in the remote Thawang village of Rolpa district in western Nepal, killing at least five people and leaving eight missing, a senior official told Anadolu on Thursday.

"Locals have recovered the bodies of five of the 15 people who went missing in the landslide, while two were injured. The location of the missing people is still unknown," Rishi Keshav Budha Magar, chairperson of Thawang Rural Municipality, which includes the landslide-affected area, said.

Around 8 pm on Wednesday (1415GMT), a landslide swept away 11 houses and sheds for cows and buffalo on sloping mountain areas.

Thawang, a remote village in the district, was once widely known as the Maoist insurgents' hinterland during the conflict, which lasted until 2006, when a peace agreement was signed.

title: What to know from AP's report about pregnant women and babies dying in Nepal amid USAID cuts - Toronto Star
description: What to know from AP's report about pregnant women and babies dying in Nepal amid USAID cuts  Toronto Star
publisher.title: Toronto Star
full_article:
GAUR, Nepal (AP) — The United States’ decision to slash its foreign aid program has led to an increase in deaths of pregnant women and babies in Nepal, The Associated Press has found.

The decision by U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration to eliminate the United States Agency for International Development last year gutted maternal and child health programs worldwide. In Nepal, the funding cuts led to the closure of nutrition and reproductive outreach programs designed to save mothers’ and babies’ lives.

The U.S. State Department says it still supports programs in Nepal aimed at improving maternal and child health. But health workers, government officials, aid workers and families in Nepal say the funding cuts have had a devastating and deadly impact on pregnant women and babies.

ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW

Here’s what to know from AP’s report on the fallout of the funding cuts:

Maternal and child health programs decimated

The decision by the Trump administration to dissolve USAID — once the world’s largest humanitarian donor — decimated nutrition programs for millions of pregnant women and children and left scores of birthing centers devoid of equipment, medicine and staff. The U.S. cuts, followed by foreign aid cuts from several other countries, forced 60%of women’s organizations to reduce their services, according to the World Health Organization.

In Nepal, the funding cuts eliminated nutrition programs that provided supplements and food items to impoverished pregnant women, and closed a program that equipped birthing centers and trained nurses, midwives and outreach workers. Those workers regularly visited pregnant women’s homes, explained the warning signs of complications and urged them to attend prenatal appointments, often escorting them there. That program reached 100,000 women and girls across Nepal in its first three years.

The fatal fallout

Because of cuts by the U.S. and other countries to foreign aid, the Gates Foundation has predicted that 2025 will be the first year this century where child deaths will increase.

In Nepal, the program closures meant many pregnant women have found it difficult to adequately feed themselves, and left them to navigate a medical system they struggle to trust or understand. As a result, pregnant women aren’t identifying complications fast enough, leading to emergencies, health workers and government officials say.

“The number of deaths of mothers, young mothers, during delivery has really increased,” says Mona Sherpa, country director for the aid group CARE Nepal, which lost more than half its funding from the U.S. cuts. “The expected number within a year is happening within four to six months.”

Babies, too, have increasingly died since the program closures. In the village of Prempur Gonahi, for example, it took just 10 months — a touch longer than a typical pregnancy — for newborns to begin dying again after the U.S. cuts, says the officer in charge, Sadho Baitha. Before CARE’s program launched in Rautahat in December 2022, Baitha says, the village averaged 10 to 15 neonatal deaths per year. By 2024, records show, there were zero. But since the program’s cancelation, newborns have begun dying again; the first was in December, and four more followed by March.

Yet many deaths linked to the funding cuts will remain invisible, in part because the cuts themselves left scores of mortality data collectors jobless. In some places, there is simply no one left to count people who died.

One mother’s agony

Most of the women helped by these canceled programs are poor, uneducated and isolated. Even if they make it to a doctor, they often struggle to understand what the doctor is saying.

The outreach workers who operated under CARE’s program would frequently visit pregnant women’s homes, escort them to prenatal appointments and act as a mediator between the women and their doctors to ensure nothing was lost in translation.

Kabita Mukhiya, for example, was a 20-year-old uneducated woman living in a poor village near the India border. When she was pregnant, she experienced excruciating stomach pains, severe swelling and delirium. She was also starving; the U.S.-funded nutrition supplements and food she received in a previous pregnancy had been eliminated by the funding cuts. And the outreach workers who once visited her village to help pregnant women had stopped coming.

Not realizing her symptoms constituted an emergency, Mukhiya suffered at home for weeks before her aunt took her to the hospital. By then, it was too late: Both she and her unborn baby died. Mukhiya died from complications of eclampsia, with severe anemia contributing significantly — both conditions that can often be identified and managed through regular prenatal care, health workers say.

Rajkumari Patel, who worked as an outreach worker under CARE’s canceled program, says deaths like Mukhiya’s were precisely what she and her colleagues had been trained to prevent.

गौर, नेपाल : अमेरिका के विदेशी सहायता कार्यक्रम में कटौती के निर्णय के कारण नेपाल में गर्भवती महिला आ शिशु के मौत में वृद्धि भेल अछि, एसोसिएटेड प्रेस के पता चलल अछि।

अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप प्रशासन द्वारा पिछला साल संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका एजेंसी फॉर इंटरनेशनल डेवलपमेंट के समाप्त करय के फैसला सं दुनिया भर मे मातृ आ बाल स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम के आंत भ गेल. नेपाल मे फंडिंग मे कटौती के कारण पोषण आ प्रजनन आउटरीच कार्यक्रम बंद भ गेल जे मां आ शिशु के जान बचाबय लेल बनाओल गेल छल.

अमेरिकी विदेश विभाग के कहनाय छनि जे ओ एखनो नेपाल मे मातृ आ बाल स्वास्थ्य मे सुधार के उद्देश्य सं कार्यक्रम के समर्थन करैत अछि. लेकिन नेपाल के स्वास्थ्यकर्मी, सरकारी अधिकारी, सहायताकर्मी आरू परिवार के कहना छै कि फंडिंग में कटौती के कारण गर्भवती महिला आरू शिशु पर विनाशकारी आरू घातक प्रभाव पड़लै ।

लेख नीचाँ जारी अछि

फंडिंग मे कटौती के परिणाम पर एपी के रिपोर्ट सं की जानय के अछि:

मातृ एवं बाल स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम नष्ट

ट्रंप प्रशासन द्वारा यूएसएआईडी - जे कहियो दुनिया केरऽ सबस॑ बड़ऽ मानवीय दाता छेलै - क॑ भंग करै के फैसला स॑ लाखों गर्भवती महिला आरू बच्चा सिनी के पोषण कार्यक्रम नष्ट होय गेलै आरू दर्जनों बर्थिंग सेंटर उपकरण, दवाई आरू कर्मचारी स॑ रहित होय गेलै । विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन के अनुसार, अमेरिकी कटौती के बाद कईटा अन्य देश के विदेशी सहायता में कटौती के कारण 60% महिला संगठन के अपन सेवा में कमी करय पड़ल.

नेपाल मे फंडिंग मे कटौती सं पोषण कार्यक्रम समाप्त भ गेल जे गरीब गर्भवती महिलाक कें पूरक आ खाद्य पदार्थ उपलब्ध कराबैत छल, आ एकटा एहन कार्यक्रम बंद भ गेल जे जन्म केंद्र आ प्रशिक्षित नर्स, दाई आ आउटरीच वर्कर कें सुसज्जित करएयत छल. ओ मजदूर नियमित रूप सं गर्भवती महिलाक घर पर जाइत छलाह, जटिलताक चेतावनी संकेत बुझबैत छलाह आ प्रसव पूर्व अपॉइंटमेंट मे उपस्थित हेबाक आग्रह करैत छलाह, प्रायः हुनका ओतय एस्कॉर्ट करैत छलाह. ओ कार्यक्रम अपन पहिल तीन साल मे पूरा नेपाल मे एक लाख महिला आ लड़की तक पहुंच गेल।

घातक फॉलआउट

अमेरिका आरू अन्य देशऽ द्वारा विदेशी सहायता म॑ कटौती के वजह स॑ गेट्स फाउंडेशन न॑ भविष्यवाणी करल॑ छै कि ई शताब्दी म॑ २०२५ पहलऽ साल होतै जब॑ बच्चा सिनी के मौत बढ़ी जैतै ।

नेपाल म॑ कार्यक्रम बंद होय के मतलब छेलै कि बहुत गर्भवती महिला सिनी क॑ पर्याप्त रूप स॑ भोजन करै म॑ दिक्कत होय गेलऽ छै, आरू ओकरा एगो ऐन्हऽ चिकित्सा प्रणाली म॑ नेविगेट करै लेली छोड़ी देलऽ गेलऽ छै जेकरा प॑ ओकरा भरोसा या समझै लेली संघर्ष करना पड़ै छै । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी आ सरकारी अधिकारीक कहब अछि जे एकर परिणाम अछि जे गर्भवती महिला जटिलताक पहचान पर्याप्त तेजी सं नहिं क’ रहल छथि, जाहि सं आपातकालीन स्थिति भ’ रहल अछि.

अमेरिकी कटौती स आधा स बेसी फंडिंग गंवा चुकल सहायता समूह केयर नेपाल क देश निदेशक मोना शेर्पा कहैत छथि जे प्रसव क दौरान मां, युवा मां क मौत क संख्या सचमुच बढ़ल अछि। “एक साल के भीतर अपेक्षित संख्या चारि स छह महीना के भीतर भ रहल अछि।”

कार्यक्रम बंद भेलाक बाद सं बच्चाक सेहो मौत बढ़ि गेल अछि. उदाहरण के लेल प्रेमपुर गोनाही गाम में अमेरिका के कटौती के बाद नवजात शिशु के फेर सं मरय में मात्र 10 महीना लागल - एकटा ठेठ गर्भावस्था सं एक स्पर्श बेसी -, प्रभारी अधिकारी साधो बैथा के कहनाय छनि. लेख नीचे जारी रहता है googletag.cmd.push (function () { googletag.display ('लेख-इंस्टोरी-लीडरबोर्ड-2'); }); लेख नीचे जारी रहता है googletag.cmd.push (function () { googletag.display ('लेख-इंस्टोरी-1'); });

बैथा के कहनाय छनि जे दिसंबर 2022 मे रौतहट मे केयर के कार्यक्रम शुरू होए सं पहिने एहि गाम मे औसतन हर साल 10 सं 15 नवजात शिशु के मौत होएत छल. रिकॉर्ड बताबैत अछि जे 2024 तक शून्य छल। मुदा जहिया सं कार्यक्रम रद्द भेल अछि, नवजात शिशु फेर सं मरय लागल अछि; पहिल दिसम्बर मे, आ चारि टा आओर ओकर बाद मार्च मे।

तइयो फंडिंग मे कटौती सं जुड़ल बहुत रास मौत अदृश्य रहत, आंशिक रूप सं एहि लेल जे एहि कटौती सं स्वयं मृत्यु दर के आंकड़ा संग्रह करय वाला के दर्जनों लोक बेरोजगार भ गेल. किछु ठाम त बस कियो नहि बचल अछि जे मरल लोक के गिनती करय.

title: It’s annual baby boom season at Nepal’s maternity hospitals - The Kathmandu Post
description: It’s annual baby boom season at Nepal’s maternity hospitals  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
For Nepal’s maternity hospitals, this is the busiest time of year.

As many as 142 women gave birth through normal delivery at Thapathali-based Paropakar Maternity and Women’s Hospital on Tuesday, while another 42 delivered by caeserean section. On Wednesday 102 women had normal deliveries and 28 had caeserean section.

Both figures are more than double the hospital’s usual daily number of deliveries.

Doctors and health workers at the hospital say the rise is not unusual. Every year, from mid-June to mid-September, the delivery rate increases significantly.

“Come to our hospital to see the patient flow,” said Dr Shanti Shrestha, senior consultant gynaecologist and obstetrician at the hospital. “Deliveries have started, and we are very busy.”

Due to an increase in the number of pregnant women seeking delivery services, all beds at the hospital have been occupied, and the hospital administration has been accommodating two new mothers in a single bed.

“We can’t turn away women who are in labour,” said Dr Shree Prasad Adhikari, director at the hospital. “Adjusting two patients in a single bed is not our choice, but an initiative we have taken to save the lives of new mothers and their babies.”

Doctors say the hospital sees a seasonal rise in deliveries from mid-June to mid-September, a period health workers call the delivery season. Normally, around 50 women give birth at the hospital each day. In recent weeks, however, daily deliveries have more than doubled on some days, and exceeded 90 on other days.

According to hospital data, 1,540 women gave birth in Baisakh (mid April-mid May), and 1,569 women in Jestha (mid May-mid June). The number increased to 1,880 in Asar (mid June-mid July). Similarly, in Chaitra (mid March-mid April), 1,452 women gave birth at the hospital.

In the month of Shrawan (mid-July to mid-August) of the last fiscal year, 2025-26, a total of 1,948 women gave birth at the hospital, while the number was 2,141 in the fiscal year 2024-025.

Adhikari said that his hospital has set up a separate observation ward to accommodate the growing number of patients.

“Women in early stages of labour or those who are not yet ready to deliver, sometimes have to share a bed,” said Adhikari. “Once labour progresses and they are ready to give birth, they are moved to the delivery room.”

The surge is not limited to Kathmandu. Hospitals in the districts are also seeing a rise in the number of women seeking delivery services.

At the Chitwan-based Bharatpur Hospital, for example, the number of deliveries has risen significantly in recent days.

“Normally, around 25 women used to seek delivery services in our hospital a day,” said Professor Sunil Mani Pokhrel, head of the gynaecology department of the hospital. “These days the number has risen to more than 40. We have been struggling to manage the beds.”

Doctors expect the number of deliveries to remain high until October. They link the seasonal rise with Nepal’s main wedding season (Mangsir, Magh, Falgun) or December through February).

Those who conceive in December usually give birth in August, those who conceive in January give birth in September, and those who conceive in February give birth in October.

“Apart from that, migrant workers, especially youths, who are abroad for employment return home during the festive season, especially Dashain and Tihar, which falls in October,” said Dr Pawan Sharma, a consultant gynaecologist. “Many couples conceive babies during this period. These days, many youths also return home planning to have a baby.”

Doctors say the chances of conception increases when young couples spend more time together and do not use contraceptives. The festive season, when people tend to relax and spend more time together, can therefore contribute to an increase in conceptions, they say.

दुनू आंकड़ा अस्पताल के सामान्य रोजाना प्रसव के संख्या सं दुगुना सं बेसि अछि.

अस्पताल के डॉक्टर आ स्वास्थ्यकर्मी के कहनाय छनि जे ई बढ़ोतरी कोनो असामान्य बात नहिं अछि. हर साल जून के मध्य सं सितंबर के मध्य तक डिलीवरी के दर काफी बढ़ैत अछि.

प्रसव सेवा चाहय वाला गर्भवती महिला के संख्या बढ़ला के कारण अस्पताल के सब बेड पर कब्जा भ गेल अछि, आ अस्पताल प्रशासन दू टा नव मां के एकल बेड पर बैसा रहल अछि.

पिछला वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 क श्रावण मास (जुलाई क मध्य स अगस्त क मध्य) मे अस्पताल मे कुल 1,948 महिला प्रसव केलथि, जखन कि वित्तीय वर्ष 2024-025 मे इ संख्या 2,141 छल।

अधिकारी कहलनि जे, हुनकर अस्पताल मे बढैत संख्या मे मरीज के ठहरय लेल अलग सं अवलोकन वार्ड के स्थापना कायल गेल अछि।

उदाहरण के तौर पर चितवन स्थित भरतपुर अस्पताल मे हाल के दिन मे प्रसव के संख्या मे काफी बढ़ोतरी भेल अछि.

सलाहकार स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञ डॉ. पवन शर्मा कहलनि जे, एकर अलावा प्रवासी मजदूर खास क युवा जे रोजगार के लेल विदेश मे रहैत छथि, त्योहार के मौसम मे घर वापस आबि जाइत छथि, खास क दशैन आ तिहार जे अक्टूबर मे पड़ैत अछि। “एहि अवधि मे बहुतो जोड़ी बच्चाक गर्भधारण करैत अछि, आइ-काल्हि बहुत रास युवा सेहो बच्चा पैदा करबाक योजना बना घर वापस आबि जाइत अछि।”

डॉक्टर के कहनाय छनि जे जखन युवा दंपति एक संग बेसि समय बिताबय छथिन्ह आओर गर्भनिरोधक के इस्तेमाल नहिं करैत छथिन्ह त गर्भधारण के संभावना बढ़ि जाइत छनि. हुनकऽ कहना छै कि उत्सव के मौसम जब॑ लोगऽ के आराम होय छै आरू एक साथ अधिक समय बिताबै के प्रवृत्ति होय छै, ई लेली परिकल्पना बढ़ै म॑ योगदान द॑ सकै छै ।

title: Sher Bahadur Deuba Returns to Nepal Amidst Internal Party Power Struggle and Legal Investigations - Ratopati
description: Sher Bahadur Deuba Returns to Nepal Amidst Internal Party Power Struggle and Legal Investigations  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Nepali Congress former president and former Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba has returned home after a stay of nearly five months abroad. Deuba, who left for Singapore on February 13 for medical treatment, returned on Thursday.

Deuba, the president elected from the 14th general convention, lost his position after a new leadership was elected from the special general convention held in the last week of January. A new working committee has been elected under the leadership of Gagan Thapa from the special general convention. With Deuba's return, the escalating power struggle within the Congress is likely to reach its 'climax'. After the special general convention, the Deuba and Dr. Shekhar Koirala group, which has been out of power, has organized a two-day national gathering in Kathmandu starting Friday.

While the establishment has been busy with the central committee meeting since July 14, there was a large crowd of his supporters to welcome Deuba at Tribhuvan International Airport on Thursday afternoon. Amidst Pancha Baja, cultural tableaux, and loud slogans, Deuba was taken to the contact office opened by the इतर group in Chundevi for the preparation of the national gathering, under tight police security, from the airport.

I have returned not to gain power but to strengthen national unity: Sher Bahadur Deuba

While this appeared to be a grand welcome for a powerful leader from the outside, a serious investigation into 'money laundering' is also hidden in its background.

The Department of Money Laundering Investigation had started an investigation against Deuba after fragments of burnt notes were found at Deuba's Budhanilkantha residence during the Janji movement on August 24, 2082. The Kathmandu District Court had even issued an arrest warrant against the Deuba couple.

However, the Supreme Court had quashed the arrest warrant issued in Deuba's name, stating that the Special Court was the 'dedicated' court to hear money laundering cases. Although the government attempted to issue a 'red notice' through Interpol, Interpol rejected it, citing insufficient grounds. With Deuba's return to Nepal, the direction this legal process will take has become a matter of concern for everyone.

Gagan's 'Welcome' and Deuba's 'Appeal'

On the same day Deuba returned home, the Congress's central working committee meeting was underway in Sanepa. Chairman Thapa, who is leading the party from the special general convention, began the meeting by wishing Deuba 'good health and welcome back home'. This welcome, as formal as it appeared, carried a profound political meaning.

The Deuba faction has been questioning the 'authenticity' of the central committee formed through the special general convention led by Thapa, and to give traction to that central working committee, a national gathering has been organized starting August 29 (tomorrow). The arrival of Deuba on the eve of this has further complicated the internal dispute within the Congress.

President Thapa begins central working committee meeting welcoming outgoing President Deuba back home

Immediately after returning home, Deuba issued an appeal stating that he 'does not want power' but will be active to 'dispel the despair within the party'. He invoked BP Koirala's National Reconciliation in 2033, attempting to present himself as a unifier.

Addressing party cadres at the contact office of the इतर group in Chundevi, Deuba symbolically said, 'King Gyanendra could not do it, can others here? The people are the masters of this country.' He also challenged those who have filed cases against him, calling them an attack on his 50 years of political integrity and stating he is ready to stand in the court of law.

What will happen in Congress now?

Deuba's return home is expected to bring about three main changes in the Congress in the current situation.

1. Challenging the working committee led by Gagan Thapa, formed through the special general convention, the इतर (Deuba and Dr. Koirala) group will now try to strengthen its hold. The gathering on August 29 will be the first step. It is also expected that the review permission granted by the Supreme Court will be fully utilized.

2. In the name of addressing the Janji movement and the dissatisfaction of the youth, Deuba is likely to adopt a strategy to counter Thapa's 'populist' politics. Some indications of this have been given in his appeal. In his appeal, Deuba stated that the party should also be transformed with the changing times and the creative capacity of the new generation should be valued, warning that past sacrifices and struggles should not be ignored: 'The party should also be transformed with the changing times and the creative capacity of the new generation should be valued. However, past sacrifices and struggles should not be ignored. We must move forward in collaboration between the new and old generations.'

3. Deuba has already interpreted the money laundering investigation and the arrest warrant as 'political revenge'. After his return to Nepal, there is a possibility that he will create pressure both on the streets and in the parliament.

काठमांडू। नेपाली कांग्रेसक पूर्व अध्यक्ष आ पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री शेरबहादुर देउवा लगभग ५ महिना विदेशमे रहला के बाद स्वदेश घुरल अछि । 13 फरवरी कए चिकित्सा क लेल सिंगापुर विदा भेल देउबा बृहस्पतिदिन वापस आबि गेलीह।

जनवरी के अंतिम सप्ताह में आयोजित विशेष आम अधिवेशन स नव नेतृत्व चुनला के बाद 14म आम अधिवेशन स निर्वाचित राष्ट्रपति देउबा अपन पद गंवा देलखिन। विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन सँ गगन थापाक नेतृत्व मे नव कार्यसमिति निर्वाचित भेल अछि । देउबा के वापसी के साथ कांग्रेस के भीतर बढ़त सत्ता संघर्ष अपनऽ ‘चरम’ पर पहुँचै के संभावना छै । विशेष आम अधिवेशन के बाद सत्ता स बाहर भ चुकल देउबा आ डॉ. शेखर कोइराला समूह काठमांडू मे शुक्रदिन स दू दिनक राष्ट्रीय सभा के आयोजन केलक अछि।

प्रतिष्ठान १४ जुलाई सँ केन्द्रीय समितिक बैसारमे व्यस्त अछि तऽ बृहस्पतिदिन दुपहरमे त्रिभुवन अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थलमे देउबाके स्वागतमे हिनकर समर्थकके भारी भीड़ छल । पंचा बाजा, सांस्कृतिक तालिका, आ जोर-जोर स नारा के बीच देउबा के एयरपोर्ट स कड़ा पुलिस सुरक्षा के तहत राष्ट्रीय सभा के तैयारी के लेल चुंदेवी में इतर समूह द्वारा खोलल गेल संपर्क कार्यालय में ल गेल गेल।

हम सत्ता प्राप्त करय लेल नहि अपितु राष्ट्रीय एकता के मजबूत करय लेल वापस आयल छी : शेर बहादुर देउबा

बाहर स॑ एगो ताकतवर नेता लेली ई एगो भव्य स्वागत के रूप म॑ लगलै, लेकिन एकरऽ पृष्ठभूमि म॑ ‘मनी लांड्रिंग’ केरऽ गंभीर जांच भी छिपलऽ छै ।

24 अगस्त 2082 के जंजी आन्दोलन के दौरान देउबा के बुधनिलकण्ठ आवास पर जरल नोट के टुकड़ा भेटला के बाद मनी लांड्रिंग जांच विभाग देउबा के खिलाफ जांच शुरू केने छल।काठमांडू जिल्ला न्यायालय देउबा दंपति के खिलाफ गिरफ्तारी वारंट तक जारी केने छल।

लेकिन सुप्रीम कोर्ट देउबा के नाम स॑ जारी गिरफ्तारी वारंट क॑ रद्द करी क॑ कहलकै कि स्पेशल कोर्ट मनी लांड्रिंग के मामला के सुनवाई लेली ‘समर्पित’ कोर्ट छेकै । हालांकि सरकार इंटरपोल के माध्यम सं ‘लाल नोटिस’ जारी करय के कोशिश केलक मुदा इंटरपोल अपर्याप्त आधार के हवाला दैत एकरा खारिज क देलक. देउबा के नेपाल वापसी के संग ई कानूनी प्रक्रिया कोन दिशा में चलत, सब के लेल चिंता के विषय बनि गेल अछि।

गगन के ‘वेलकम’ आ देउबा के ‘अपील’।

ओही दिन देउबा घर घुरला पर सनेपा मे कांग्रेस के केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति के बैसार चलि रहल छल । विशेष आम अधिवेशन स पार्टी के नेतृत्व करय वाला अध्यक्ष थापा देउवा के ‘सुस्वास्थ्य आ घर वापसी के स्वागत’ के शुभकामना दैत बैसार के शुरुआत केलनि। ई स्वागत जतेक औपचारिक बुझाइत छल, एकटा गहींर राजनीतिक अर्थ धारण करैत छल ।

देउवा गुट थापा के नेतृत्व में विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के माध्यम स गठित केन्द्रीय समिति के ‘प्रामाणिकता’ पर सवाल ठाढ़ करैत आबि रहल अछि, आ ओहि केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति के कर्षण देबय लेल 29 अगस्त (काल्हि) स राष्ट्रीय सभा के आयोजन कायल गेल अछि। एकर पूर्व संध्या पर देउबा के आगमन कांग्रेस के भीतर के आतंरिक विवाद के आओर जटिल बना देलक अछि.

राष्ट्रपति थापा निवर्तमान राष्ट्रपति देउबा के घर वापसी के स्वागत करैत केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति के बैसार शुरू केलनि

घर वापसी के तुरंत बाद देउबा अपील जारी करैत कहलक जे हुनका ‘सत्ता नहि चाही’ मुदा ‘पार्टी के भीतर निराशा दूर करय लेल’ सक्रिय रहताह। ओ २०३३ मे बीपी कोइराला के राष्ट्रीय मेलमिलाप के आह्वान केलनि, जाहि मे ओ अपना के एकीकृत करय वाला के रूप मे पेश करय के कोशिश केलनि.

चुण्डेवी स्थित इतर समूह के संपर्क कार्यालय मे पार्टी कार्यकर्ता के संबोधित करैत देउबा सांकेतिक रूप सँ कहलनि जे राजा ज्ञानेन्द्र ई काज नहि क' सकलाह, एतय दोसर लोकनि क' सकैत छथि? जनता एहि देशक मालिक अछि।' हुनका पर मुकदमा दायर करय वाला के सेहो चुनौती दैत हुनका हुनकर 50 साल के राजनीतिक अखंडता पर हमला बताबैत कहलखिन्ह आओर ओ अदालत मे ठाढ़ होबय लेल तैयार छथिन्ह.

आब कांग्रेस मे की होयत?

देउबा के घर वापसी सं वर्तमान स्थिति मे कांग्रेस मे तीन मुख्य बदलाव आबय के उम्मीद अछि.

1. विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के माध्यम स बनल गगन थापा के नेतृत्व में कार्यसमिति के चुनौती दैत इतर (देउबा आ डॉ. कोइराला) समूह आब अपन पकड़ मजबूत करबाक प्रयास करत। 29 अगस्त कए होए वाला सभा पहिल डेग होएत। संगहि उम्मीद अछि जे सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा देल गेल समीक्षा अनुमति क पूर्ण उपयोग होएत।

2. जंजी आन्दोलन आ युवा के असंतोष के संबोधित करय के नाम पर देउवा थापा के ‘लोकवादी’ राजनीति के प्रतिकार के रणनीति अपनाबय के संभावना अछि. हुनकर अपील मे एकर किछु संकेत देल गेल अछि। देउबा अपन अपील मे बदलैत समय के संग पार्टी के सेहो परिवर्तन होबाक चाही आ नव पीढ़ी के सृजनात्मक क्षमता के महत्व देबय के बात कहैत विगत बलिदान आ संघर्ष के नजरअंदाज नहि करबाक चेतावनी दैत कहलनि जे, ‘बदलैत समय के संग पार्टी के सेहो परिवर्तन होबाक चाही आ नव पीढ़ी के रचनात्मक क्षमता के महत्व देल जाय। ओना पूर्वक त्याग आ संघर्ष के नजरअंदाज नहि करबाक चाही। नव-पुरान पीढ़ीक सहयोगसँ आगू बढ़बाक चाही।'

3. देउबा मनी लांड्रिंग के जांच आ गिरफ्तारी वारंट के ‘राजनीतिक बदला’ के रूप में व्याख्या क चुकल छथि। नेपाल वापसी के बाद सड़क पर आ संसद दुनू ठाम दबाव पैदा करय के संभावना अछि.

full_article:
EDGEWATER — The first street festival dedicated to celebrating the Nepali community in Chicago is coming to Edgewater.

Nepalese Aid, a nonprofit founded in 2022 to support first-generation Nepali immigrants, is holding the inaugural Nepali Street Festival noon-8 p.m. Saturday on Kenmore Avenue between Hollywood and Bryn Mawr avenues.

The event will have live music, cultural performances and traditional Nepali food from Chicago restaurants like Kathmandu Cafe in Edgewater and KTM Kitchen in the Loop, said Nepalese Aid Founder Rajan Shahi.

“Hopefully people come and learn something new about Nepal,” said Shahi, who moved to Edgewater from Nepal in 2009. “My long-term goal and dream is when someone talks about Edgewater, people right away think about the Nepali community.”

There are an estimated 3,000 Nepali immigrants residing in Edgewater, according to Ald. Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth’s 48th Ward Office.

That means about 20 percent of the entire Nepali immigrant community in the Chicago area call Edgewater home, Shahi said.

It’s not clear exactly how Edgewater became a popular neighborhood for Nepali immigrants, but Shahi speculated that it only takes a few families moving to a neighborhood to start recommending it as a place for others to also come.

Shahi’s goal with hosting the Nepali Street Festival is for first-generation Nepali families to feel proud to live in Edgewater and introduce the community to the broader neighborhood, he said.

“My first home is in Edgewater, so it’s very meaningful to me that I do something for the neighborhood,” he said.

A new Edgewater mural representing the Nepali immigrant community in Chicago. Credit: Madison Savedra/Block Club Chicago

Shahi also helped advocate for a recent mural that was painted in Edgewater near the intersection of Broadway and Glenlake Avenue, representing Nepali culture in Chicago.

The mural by artist Jeff Zimmermann depicts several Nepali people — some of them real Edgewater neighbors who posed for the mural — and traditional Nepali dishes, like momo. It also incorporates elements of the flag of Nepal with the Chicago flag.

At the bottom of the mural, it says in Nepali and written in Devanagari script, “From Nepal to Chicago, our culture, our community, our identity,” Shahi said.

“The mural represents the journey from Nepal to Chicagoland and the idea that immigrants can carry their culture with them while building a new home here,” he said.

You can see all the details about the Nepali Street Festival on the organization’s social media.

एजवाटर — शिकागो केरऽ नेपाली समुदाय क॑ मनाबै लेली समर्पित पहलऽ सड़क महोत्सव एजवाटर म॑ आबी रहलऽ छै ।

पहिल पीढ़ी के नेपाली आप्रवासी के सहयोग के लेल 2022 में स्थापित एकटा गैर-लाभकारी संस्था नेपाली एड के उद्घाटन नेपाली स्ट्रीट फेस्टिवल दुपहर-8 बजे सं आयोजित भ रहल अछि. हॉलीवुड आ ब्राइन मावर एवेन्यू के बीच केनमोर एवेन्यू पर शनिदिन.

एहि आयोजन मे एजवाटर मे काठमांडू कैफे आ लूप मे केटीएम किचन जेहन शिकागो रेस्टोरेंट स लाइव संगीत, सांस्कृतिक प्रस्तुति आ पारंपरिक नेपाली भोजन होएत नेपाली एड के संस्थापक राजन शाही कहलनि।

2009 मे नेपाल स एजवाटर आबि गेल शाही कहला जे आशा अछि जे लोक आबि कए नेपाल क बारे मे किछु नव सीखत।हमर दीर्घकालीन लक्ष्य आ सपना इ अछि जे जखन कियो एजवाटर क गप करैत अछि त लोक तुरंत नेपाली समुदाय क बारे मे सोचैत अछि।

एजवाटर मे लगभग ३ हजार नेपाली आप्रवासी निवास करैत अछि, एल्ड के अनुसार । लेनी मना-हॉपेनवर्थ के 48 वीं वार्ड कार्यालय |

मतलब शिकागो इलाका के पूरा नेपाली आप्रवासी समुदाय के करीब 20 प्रतिशत एजवाटर के घर कहैत शाही कहलनि.

ई ठीक-ठीक स्पष्ट नै छै कि एजवाटर नेपाली आप्रवासी के लेलऽ लोकप्रिय मोहल्ला कोना बनलै, लेकिन शाही न॑ अनुमान लगैलकै कि एकरा दोसरऽ लोगऽ के भी आबै के जगह के रूप म॑ सिफारिश करना शुरू करै लेली खाली कुछ परिवारऽ क॑ कोनो मोहल्ला म॑ आबै के जरूरत छै ।

नेपाली स्ट्रीट फेस्टिवल के आयोजन के साथ शाही के लक्ष्य छै कि प्रथम पीढ़ी के नेपाली परिवार एजवाटर में रहय में गर्व महसूस करय आ समुदाय के व्यापक मोहल्ला स परिचित कराबय।

ओ कहलनि जे, हमर पहिल घर एजवाटर मे अछि, ताहि लेल हमरा लेल ई बहुत सार्थक अछि जे हम मोहल्ला लेल किछु करी।

शिकागो में नेपाली आप्रवासी समुदाय के प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला एकटा नव एजवाटर भित्ति चित्र. साभार: मैडिसन सेवेड्रा/ब्लॉक क्लब शिकागो

शाही न॑ हाल केरऽ एगो भित्ति चित्र केरऽ वकालत म॑ भी मदद करलकै जे ब्रॉडवे आरू ग्लेनलेक एवेन्यू केरऽ चौराहा के पास एजवाटर म॑ चित्रित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, जे शिकागो म॑ नेपाली संस्कृति के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छेलै ।

कलाकार जेफ ज़िमरमैन केरऽ भित्ति चित्र म॑ कईएक नेपाली लोगऽ के चित्रण छै — जेकरा म॑ स॑ कुछ वास्तविक एजवाटर पड़ोसी छेलै जे भित्ति चित्र लेली पोज देलकै — आरू पारंपरिक नेपाली व्यंजन, जेना कि मोमो । एहि मे नेपालक झंडाक तत्व सेहो शिकागोक झंडाक संग समावेश कएल गेल अछि ।

भित्ति चित्रक निचला भागमे नेपाली आ देवनागरी लिपिमे लिखल लिखल अछि, “नेपालसँ लऽ कऽ शिकागो धरि हमर संस्कृति, हमर समुदाय, हमर पहिचान” शाही कहलनि ।

ओ कहलनि जे, भित्ति चित्र नेपाल सं शिकागोलैंड के यात्रा आ एहि विचार के प्रतिनिधित्व करैत अछि जे आप्रवासी एतय नव घर बनाबैत अपन संस्कृति के संग ल क जा सकैत छथि।

नेपाली स्ट्रीट फेस्टिवल के बारे मे सभटा विवरण संस्था के सोशल मीडिया पर देख सकय छी.
